assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone modular game-character layer for SLIME POP. Image1 is the APPROVED CARTOON STYLE: smooth clean color planes, bold friendly dark contours, controlled small white shines, simple2-3tone cel shading, cute mainstream casual mobile game art. Image2 is SUBJECT/DESIGN ONLY, ignore its existing crayon grain and huge transparent canvas. Redraw the requested layer cleanly with no crayon/pencil/watercolor grain, rough smudges, realism or exaggerated3D. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha only outside the actual shapes. Every filled shape must be fully OPAQUE, no accidental alpha holes, partial-opacity face areas or central gray cloud. TIGHT BOUNDS are critical: fill essentially the ENTIRE requested canvas, with each outermost top/bottom/left/right extremity within0-1% of its image edge. Do not surround a small drawing with a big invisible square. Preserve the natural aspect ratio of the subject using the specified canvas. No labels, letters, numbers, ground shadows, extra costume, background or UI frame. SUBJECT: ONLY a simple cute SLIME EXPRESSION layer: two black oval eyes spaced widely apart and a tiny black U-shaped smile centered between and slightly below them. Exactly three filled face marks; each eye may have one tiny white specular dot INSIDE its black oval. WIDE LANDSCAPE3:1 canvas tightly bounding the entire eye-and-mouth arrangement, the top of eyes near top edge, bottom of smile near bottom edge, left and right eyes close to left/right canvas edges. All remaining pixels transparent, including the gaps BETWEEN eyes and mouth. There is NO face background, head, white body, cheeks, brows, nose, border or skin patch. Friendly clean cartoon marks with consistent smooth dark contour.

canvas.placement: body-aligned 1024 square: expression width 369px, height 123px, left 327px, top 502px; surrounding alpha is intentional positioning
